item.title: pgAdmin 4 Import/Export Data psql TO PROGRAM Command Injection (CVE-2026-17566)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.9) — web · CVE-2026-17566 (CWE-78, CWE-115). Status: PoC (the author states the request path and payload are implemented from public analysis and have not been validated against a live instance). Affects: pgAdmin 4, Import/Export Data tool (POST /import_export/job/<sid>). Tags: pgadmin4, postgresql, psql, copy-to-program, command-injection, cwe-78, cwe-115, authenticated, rce, python.
